title: Due Diligence
text: I sent money to a dude in a hot tub in Hawaii to 5× my money. OUTRAGE! SHOCKING! To be fair, he called it a 'donation' and a 'game'.

image.alt: Meme of a grinning man in a glowing hot tub at sunset, phone on a tripod marked LIVE, with the joke as captions; below it, a chat reply reading: Bro, this one is your best yet, followed by crying-laughing emoji and 'omg ahhahahahaah', then a second reply: Wow.
image.caption: Exhibit A — field reaction, 16 October, 22:50. Witness identity withheld.

bonuses.label: Unexpected
bonuses.why: 'To be fair.' The victim rises to the defence of the man in the hot tub.

bonuses.label: Relatable
bonuses.why: Every reader has watched someone do exactly this. Some have watched themselves.

bonuses.label: Visual Aid
bonuses.why: The phone on the tripod is marked LIVE. The transaction is being streamed.

bonuses.label: Slant Rhyme
bonuses.why: Awarded on a grievance from the Labour Union of Joke Interpreters. HAWAII / MONEY upheld: both end a line and land on the same unstressed 'ee'. FAIR / GAME rejected as cited: different vowel, different ending. The union missed the stronger pair: DONATION / GAME share a stressed 'ay', and they are the two words in scare quotes.

bonuses.label: Audience Amplifier
bonuses.why: Documented in Exhibit A: seven crying-laughing emoji, an unbroken 'ahhahahahaah', and a second witness reduced to 'Wow'. The reaction is funnier than most jokes, which is the multiplier's entire definition.

bonuses.label: Legendary
bonuses.why: Testimony of The Management: a housemate, shown neither the joke nor the reaction, laughed at a spoken account of the situation alone. The laughter survived the loss of both the joke and the witness. That is the literal meaning of legendary: a story that still works when it is retold.

note: The first specimen to exceed the instrument, and the first to hold position 11, not by arithmetic but by conferral, on evidence of third-hand transmission. Designated the Gold Standard: the upper reference for all future readings, as Specimen 002 anchors the lower. The Inspectorate further finds that no fraud occurred: the terms were disclosed in full, and they were 'donation' and 'game'. Record of amendments: Slant Rhyme awarded on appeal (raw 16 to 17, needle unmoved); Legendary conferred 17 October 2026 (raw 17 to 51, needle at 11). The chain reaction has not been observed to terminate.

title: The Humour Uncertainty Principle
text: You can know how funny something is, or you can laugh at it — never both at once. The preservation law holds, though. The LOLness isn't destroyed. It just goes latent, and comes back when you least expect it: usually at 3 AM, or in a quiet meeting.

image.alt: Prof. F. L. Amingo, a pink flamingo in a tweed jacket and bow tie, lecturing at a whiteboard titled The Satirical Uncertainty Principle, with the equation delta satire times delta laughter is at least h-bar sub s and a graph of laughter falling as measurement rises. On the desk, a mug reading I measure, therefore I maybe laugh. Below, a certificate from the Joke Regulation Authority, Inspectorate of Satire, and a laughter meter reading 32.7 LOL units.
image.caption: Exhibit A — the original lecture. Prof. F. L. Amingo presiding.

bonuses.label: Originality
bonuses.why: Uncertainty jokes are common. Conservation of LOLness is not.

bonuses.label: Relatable
bonuses.why: Everyone has been ambushed by a latent joke in a room where laughing was a bad idea.

bonuses.label: Unexpected
bonuses.why: The pivot from uncertainty to conservation is the actual gag.

note: The specimen demonstrates its own thesis. It was measurably funnier before we measured it. Per its own preservation law, that LOLness is not gone — it is latent, and it will find you.

title: Calibration Standard
text: Why did the chicken cross the road? To get to the other side.
note: Retained permanently as the Inspectorate's reference specimen. Every instrument requires a known quantity to calibrate against, and this one has not moved in one hundred and seventy years. Do not laugh at it. If you laugh at it, the instrument is broken and must be recertified.

title: Terms of Service
text: The Joke Regulation Authority has determined that explaining a joke does not violate it, but does void the warranty.

bonuses.label: Originality
bonuses.why: Bureaucratic framing applied to an observation everyone already agrees with.

bonuses.label: Unexpected
bonuses.why: 'Void the warranty' arrives one clause later than you brace for.

note: Filed without objection. Claims made against explained jokes will not be honoured.

title: Half-Life
text: Every joke has a half-life. Puns decay fastest — they emit a groan and become a fact.

bonuses.label: Originality
bonuses.why: The decay product is correctly identified. Puns really do become facts.

bonuses.label: Unexpected
bonuses.why: 'Emit a groan' is doing physics and comedy in the same three words.

note: Short, load-bearing, no wasted clause. The Inspectorate notes that this specimen has itself already decayed twice during review.

title: Retention Schedule
text: We classify jokes by how long they survive being repeated at work. Category A: forever. Category B: until Thursday. Category C: it was never funny, you were just tired.

bonuses.label: Relatable
bonuses.why: Category C is a diagnosis, and the reader has been the patient.

bonuses.label: Originality
bonuses.why: The taxonomy is the joke. The third category is where it turns on you.

note: The escalating-list structure is standard. The final item declining to be a joke at all is what earns the score.

title: Chiasmus
text: Comedy is tragedy plus time. Tragedy is comedy minus timing.

bonuses.label: Originality
bonuses.why: The first half is inherited. The second half is the contribution, and it is a real one.

bonuses.label: Unexpected
bonuses.why: Time and timing are one letter and an entire career apart.

note: The Inspectorate acknowledges the opening clause is not original and has elected not to penalise it, on the grounds that the reversal could not exist without it.

title: Satire Non-Proliferation Treaty
text: You can inspect a stockpile of warheads. You cannot inspect a stockpile of jokes that haven't landed yet — because per the uncertainty principle, measuring them disarms them. Measurement constitutes disarmament.

image.alt: Prof. F. L. Amingo, a pink flamingo in pink camouflage, a beret and aviator sunglasses, arms crossed beside a poster headed SNPT, Satire Non-Proliferation Treaty. The poster reads: You can inspect a stockpile of warheads. You cannot inspect a stockpile of jokes that haven't landed yet, because per the uncertainty principle, measuring them disarms them. Measurement constitutes disarmament. On the desk: a pink grenade reading Punch up, not down; a mug reading Weaponize wit, defuse ego, upgrade reality; and a classified folder whose mission is Make reality more tolerable.
image.caption: Exhibit A — treaty text as posted. Battalion of Militarized Satire, Prof. F. L. Amingo commanding.

submittedBy: Prof. F. L. Amingo, Ph.D., Commanding Officer, Battalion of Militarized Satire

bonuses.label: Originality
bonuses.why: Arms-control law is not a worn path to a punchline, and the treaty language fits the physics exactly.

bonuses.label: Unexpected
bonuses.why: The asymmetry does it — warheads hold still to be counted, jokes do not.

bonuses.label: Visual Aid
bonuses.why: Pink multicam and aviators. The grenade reads PUNCH UP. NOT DOWN.

note: A treaty with no workable verification regime is normally worthless. This one is the exception: the inspection clause is unenforceable by construction, which makes the treaty self-executing. The Inspectorate has therefore been in continuous compliance since before it was drafted, and intends to remain so by doing nothing.

title: The Satirical Uncertainty Principle
text: A flamingo in a tweed jacket holds the J.R.A. Chair of Ironic Studies. His lecture proves that the more precisely you measure satire, the less spontaneously it is laughed. His mug reads I MEASURE, THEREFORE I MAYBE LAUGH. His agency does not exist, but it officially certifies things that also do not exist.

bonuses.label: Visual Aid
bonuses.why: The flamingo is not decoration. The joke does not survive without the tweed.

bonuses.label: Originality
bonuses.why: Four layers of meta held together by a bird with reading glasses.

bonuses.label: Unexpected
bonuses.why: The mug. Every time, the mug.

note: Certifying nonexistent things through a nonexistent agency is the founding act of this institution. Specimen 007 is therefore both evidence and jurisdiction.
